Hello again! I hope you’ve been doing well!
I’m back with another commission request, if you don’t mind!
This time, I would love an illustration of my new OC.

Character reference: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1nYGqULCdtE2tJlZ0ba9pr2SFGEOjO6t3?usp=drive_link
Character settings: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/16OjIR5e-gWSwNyLdUPEmWLyyhcVDF5H2?usp=drive_link

Design notes (just in case they’re easy to miss):
-Kuudere personality
-Heterochromia (one blue eye, one violet eye)
-Gold, star-shaped earrings
-Two feathers on the right side of her head
-Side braids hairstyle in the reference (the loose hair in the back view is not the same style)

For the scene, I'd like to see her sitting alone on a bench, hugging either an arctic fox or a white rabbit.
The setting is a nighttime festival in a fantasy-themed world — while others enjoy the lively market, she stays in a quiet spot, enjoying her peaceful moment.

Mood + atmosphere reference: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Q340MSCzgrLBSBykQkdCQ3FcjvXypFDn?usp=drive_link

I might be troubling you, but if possible, could you put her in a more casual outfit?
Outfit reference: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1yoFar3FbOrTIIKNs367fFlKCoYHTHQ3J?usp=drive_link

Feel free to adjust the hairstyle too if you think it suits the artwork better, it doesn't have to be the 2 hairstyles in the reference — I fully trust your artistic sense!

Thank you so much as always!
